name: Watchlight
description: Keep the lighthouse burning through the storm. Guide ships home and drive back what rises from the sea.

controls.action: Aim the lamp on the water
Chart, oil can, pet the cat

help: Keep a ship in the light until it reads Guided and it steers back to the safe line. Amber quiets sirens, Blue halts false lights, Red burns the Drowned faster. Heat cracks the lens; oil and power run out. Gallery: harpoons, flares, the hammer. Watch room: radio, horn, crank. Survive twelve nights; spend the days on the tower. Friends take the other stations.

badges.name: First Light
badges.description: Keep the lamp through night one.

badges.name: Safe Harbour
badges.description: Ten ships home in one night.

badges.name: No Wrecks
badges.description: A night with nothing on the reef.

badges.name: Out Of Oil
badges.description: Finish a night on the crank and a dry wick.

badges.name: Lightning Rod
badges.description: Take a strike and keep the lamp lit to dawn.
